additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440651-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R3 170001548] Free of charge transactions CRM:02681000536
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
I have identified another charger where Free of Charge transactions are occurring.
The customer has shared the below screenshot from their backend portal, and after cross-checking the logs on the charger for the specified timestamps, I can confirm that this behavior indeed happened.
Specifically, at 16:25, a charging session is initiated, and shortly after, the charger sends a StopTransaction to the backend. However, the charging process continues. The session is manually stopped at 16:39, resulting in a Free of Charge transaction during this interval.
